names.zh: 北极熊安全区边界标志

derivedFrom.context: Leaving the settlement zone without polar bear protection is illegal and life-threatening.

actionItem.en: Do NOT pass this sign without a high-caliber rifle and flare gun (or an armed guide).
actionItem.zh: 没有携带大口径步枪和信号枪（或武装向导），严禁越过此标志。

derivedFrom.context: Svalbard is outside Schengen. Strict ID control applies.

actionItem.en: Present valid Passport (or National ID for EU/EEA) upon arrival and departure.
actionItem.zh: 抵离时必须出示有效护照（欧盟/EEA公民可用身份证）。

derivedFrom.context: Alcohol sales are rationed and require flight documentation.

actionItem.en: Bring your boarding pass to purchase alcohol. Check opening hours (closed early).
actionItem.zh: 购买酒精需出示登机牌。注意营业时间（关门较早）。

derivedFrom.context: All traces of human activity from before 1946 are protected cultural heritage.

actionItem.en: Do not touch or remove any loose objects/artifacts found in the buildings or on the ground.
actionItem.zh: 不要触摸或带走建筑物内或地面上发现的任何松散物体/文物。
